name: Cinematics
state: PR 1 merged (a rule over every boss fight; no boss event slows time). PR 2 (the Warden and the Colossus change phase in the fight) in review. Look board waiting for the owner
summary: Boss phase changes stop the fight today: a ritual script freezes the combat step, locks the player and waits for a tap or a reading timeout (5.1-6.8 s each; the Source descent 11.5 s; Rootbound stands still for 12.9 s of a 32-37 s fight). Chapter openings take 25-39 s at Full. The plan makes every in-fight beat a boss move with at most a banner, cuts chapter openings and the finale to short cards that never wait, replaces the cinematic director and ritual layer with one stage beat, and adds a rule over every boss that no tick blocks input or the combat step.
next: PR 3 (Aldric) and PR 4 (the Source) take out the remaining rituals; then PR 5 deletes the blocking path. The banner, chapter card and epilogue (PRs 6-8) wait for the owner’s verdict on the look board.
owner_action: Approve or correct the look board on the ledger.
